name: AI Alt Text Generator for Images – AltTextLab
author: AltTextLab

sections.description:
AltTextLab – AI Alt Text Generator for WordPress

AltTextLab helps website owners and online stores improve SEO and accessibility by automatically adding meaningful, descriptive alt text to all images. Powered by advanced AI, the plugin supports bulk alt text generation, allowing you to optimize hundreds of images in just minutes — no manual work required.

🔍 Automatic Alt Text Generation
Every new image uploaded to your WordPress media library is analyzed and assigned AI-generated alt text that accurately reflects its content. It all happens automatically at upload — no extra effort needed.

⚡ Bulk Processing for Your Media Library
Generate alt text for your entire WordPress media library in just a few clicks. Save hours of work with fast and reliable batch generation.

📁 Supports All Major Image Formats
Compatible with JPG, PNG, WebP, SVG, and AVIF, ensuring full support for today’s most common and modern image formats.

🛍 WooCommerce Integration
AltTextLab understands your product pages and smartly includes product names and brand in the alt text — boosting your store’s SEO performance.

🧩 SEO Plugin Integration
Works seamlessly with popular SEO plugins like Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress, and others. Focus keyphrases are naturally included in the generated alt text.

🌍 Multi-language Support
Generate alt text in over 130 languages.

🚀 Easy Start & Free Trial
Get started in minutes with a simple installation and a free trial — no credit card required.

External service for alt text generation

This WordPress plugin connects to the API provided by AltTextLab.com to generate alt text for images using AI. This service is essential for the plugin’s core functionality.

What data is sent and when:

The plugin may send the following data to AltTextLab when generating alt text:
– The image URL or a base64-encoded version of the image
– Keywords
– The article or product title
– Brand and other relevant attributes, depending on plugin settings

The plugin may also send a request to fetch the current status of the connected AltTextLab account in order to display account information within the WordPress admin interface.

This external service is provided by AltTextLab.com. Terms of Service, Privacy Policy

Demo Video
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “AltTextLab”.
  3. Click Install and then Activate the plugin.
  4. Sign up for a free trial or select a paid plan at alttextlab.com.
  5. Connect your account by entering your API key in the plugin settings.
  6. Upload an image — alt text will be generated automatically!
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

AltTextLab automatically adds alternative text (alt text) to images on your website using AI. This improves SEO and makes your site more accessible to users with visual impairments.

How does the alt text generation work?

By default, the plugin sends only a public image URL to the AltTextLab server, which is enough for the AI to analyze the content and generate a relevant description. However, if your site or media is not publicly accessible, you can enable an option in the settings to upload the image itself instead. In both cases, the AI processes the image and returns descriptive alt text based on its visual content and your configured settings (such as product name, brand, or keywords).

Is there a free version?

Yes, you can start with a free trial, no credit card required.

Which images are processed?

If automatic generation is enabled, all images uploaded to the WordPress Media Library will automatically receive AI-generated alt text.
You can use the bulk generation tool to process all media files, post images, product photos, and page graphics.

Can it generate alt text for WooCommerce product images?

Yes! AltTextLab is fully compatible with WooCommerce and can automatically generate alt text for WooCommerce product images. The plugin understands product pages and includes relevant details like the product name and brand.

Is it compatible with my SEO plugin?

Yes. AltTextLab works with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress, and other popular SEO plugins. If you’re using focus keywords, they can be naturally included in the generated alt text.

Does it support multilingual sites?

AltTextLab supports 130+ languages. You can select the desired language for alt text generation in the plugin settings.

Does the plugin work on localhost or private sites?

Yes. You can generate alt text even if your site is running locally or is not publicly accessible (e.g. behind a password). This is ideal for development environments or internal websites.
To enable this, simply uncheck the option “This site is reachable over the public internet” in the plugin settings — the image will then be uploaded directly to the server for analysis instead of using a public URL.

Will the plugin overwrite my existing alt text?

By default, AltTextLab does not replace any manually written alt text — it only fills in missing fields.
However, if you want to regenerate alt text for any images (including those that already have it), you can do so manually. The bulk generation tool also allows you to choose whether to generate new alt text for all images, regardless of whether they already have existing text.
